facts.business: Prudential Sugar Corporation Limited is engaged in the sugar manufacturing business and has investments in subsidiaries including Prudential Ammana Sugars Limited and Helios Sustainable Energy Limited.

auditor.name: PPKG & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Non-compliance with Ind AS 101 conversion provisions at transition date and lack of fair value measurement documentation; 2) Unconfirmed/unreconciled advances to/from various parties; 3) Balances of current/non-current assets and liabilities subject to confirmations/reconciliations; 4) Pending legal cases with uncertain outcomes; 5) Inter-balance transfers/adjustments without proper confirmations, agreements or consent from parties.

key_risks: Non-compliance with Ind AS 101 transition provisions
Unconfirmed and unreconciled advances and balances
Pending legal cases with uncertain outcomes
Inter-balance transfers without proper documentation and confirmations
